newsitem.title: CANADA: CanOxy wins Colombia exploration rights.
newsitem.headline: CanOxy wins Colombia exploration rights.

text.p: Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd said on Wednesday that wholly owned unit Canadian Petroleum Colombia Ltd won the right to explore the Troyano Block in Colombia in partnership with the country's state-owned oil company, Ecopetrol.
The Troyano was one of two blocks offered out of Ecopetrol's reserve acreage in the private exploration bid round that closed on October 7.

Under the terms of the risk-sharing agreement, Ecopetrol and CanOxy will share all costs equally, the company said. CanOxy said it would be entitled to 42 percent of production from the acreage, in which Ecopetrol will be operator.

The Colombian deal is the second new exploration area anounced by CanOxy in as many days. On Tuesday, the company said it signed a production sharing contract covering operations on the Offshore Seram Block in eastern Indonesia.
The Troyano Block is located in the Putomayo basin along the Colombia-Ecuador border.

The company said it identified "an attractive, moderate risk, high reserve potential drilling prospect" which it expected to drill an exploratory well in the first half of 1997. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
